question: Flying insect biomass in German reserves fell 76% over 27 years. At a steady yearly rate, about what percentage was lost each year?
move: Losses compound: a steady small rate empties more than it sounds.
ask: What small yearly loss in my money, health or friendships is quietly compounding?
trap: Dividing 76% by 27 years gives under 3% a year.
hint: Find a yearly rate that, applied 27 times over, leaves 24%.
steps: Try losing 5% a year: 0.95 multiplied by itself 27 times ≈ 0.25
That leaves 25%, close to the 24% measured
reference: Hallmann et al., More than 75 percent decline over 27 years in total flying insect biomass in protected areas, PLoS ONE, 2017
